features: POWERFUL AUDIO: Proudly designed and manufactured in India, the Tronica Super King 5.1 Bluetooth speaker delivers a robust 40W output with deep, punchy bass, crystal-clear sound, and high-fidelity audio. Perfect for home theatre, party speaker, living room, gaming, movies, and multimedia entertainment.

SEAMLESS 5.1 MULTIMEDIA AUDIO: Immersive 5-speaker plus 1-subwoofer setup delivers balanced sound with crisp vocals and surround-like effects (Note: multi-channel distribution; does not support virtual Dolby/true surround decoding). Perfect for gaming, movies, house parties, and streaming music.

FULL-FUNCTION REMOTE CONTROL: Control your audio effortlessly from your sofa using the sleek remote. Switch modes, adjust volume, change FM stations, skip tracks, and manage your playlist with ease. Great for convenient home entertainment, karaoke, and wireless music control.

UNIVERSAL MULTI-INPUT CONNECTIVITY: Lag-free Bluetooth for smartphones, laptops, and tablets, plus USB, SD card, AUX input, and built-in FM radio. Supports wired and wireless playback for music streaming, gaming, podcasts, movies, and party playlists. Compatible with Android, iOS, PC, and other devices.

PREMIUM AUDIO EXPERIENCE: Tronica Super King 5.1 Bluetooth speaker, proudly made in India, delivers rich 40W sound with thumping bass and crystal-clear highs. Perfect for home theatre, living room, bedroom, gaming, parties, and music streaming.
